repro: View /pricing in paper-card context or share page: Button variant=ghost renders near-invisible on Card variant=paper (dark-shell ghost tokens do not flip on paper surfaces). T21b fixed its own instance locally in OpenAllButton; PricingToggle.tsx instance remains.
expected: Ghost buttons legible on paper surfaces
actual: Invisible/illegible ghost button on kraft background
resolution: Card variant="paper" now stamps data-surface="paper" (Card.tsx) and tokens.css scopes --text/--text-2/--line/--line-hi/--surface-hover under [data-surface="paper"], so every nested component (Button ghost, LinkButton ghost) inherits paper-legible tokens automatically; OpenAllButton's local workaround was reverted to plain Button variant="ghost" to prove it.

repro: Full-suite runs intermittently fail the t18 PRO round-trip e2e test; passes in isolation. Seen twice across T20 implementation + fix runs.
actual: Intermittent timing flake under suite load
resolution: Reproduced under load (--repeat-each 3 + parallel pnpm -r test/busy-loop CPU churn, load avg 17.8 on 8 cores): device B's post-sync grid assertion saw 0 links for the full 8s expect-timeout even though device A's push had already resolved, because "Sync now" re-enabling only proves requestSync() resolved, not that it ran a real push+pull (it resolves identically on a silent {skipped:...} gate outcome, and can race the background service worker's own periodic sync-interval alarm on the same device). Added a syncUntil() helper that retries the whole sync-click+verify cycle up to 3x with backoff instead of trusting one click; applied at all 4 sync-then-verify checkpoints; test.setTimeout raised 120s->180s for retry headroom. Reproduced clean on 3/3 repeat-each runs under the same load after the fix.

repro: t20 @live-ai e2e test fails independent of T23b changes (was passing during T20). Pre-existing regression or transient Anthropic API issue — needs diagnosis: check function logs, key validity, quota state, API status.
expected: @live-ai happy path passes when env is configured
actual: Fails as of T23b full-suite runs
resolution: Root cause confirmed via docker exec ... env on supabase_edge_runtime_tabburrow: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was entirely absent from the running edge-runtime container's process env (Anthropic API itself verified healthy via a direct curl: 200 OK on the same model). supabase start has no --env-file flag and config.toml's [edge_runtime.secrets] block was commented out, so the container's Stripe/SITE_URL vars (present) came from a one-off T23a-era `supabase functions serve --env-file <stripe-only-temp-file>` session whose container was left running after ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was omitted from that file; ai-organize/index.ts's `if (!anthropicKey) return errorResponse("upstream",502)` guard fired on every call, surfaced by the extension as "AI organize is temporarily unavailable." Fixed by populating config.toml's [edge_runtime.secrets] with env(ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) plus the existing Stripe/SITE_URL vars, then `supabase stop && supabase start` (with root .env sourced into the shell) so a single `supabase start` is now the drift-proof source of truth. Verified: docker exec env now shows ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; @live-ai and @live-stripe both pass.

repro: Under parallel system load, t14 popup-speed perf test and t18 PRO round-trip intermittently fail full-suite runs; both pass in isolation. F2 tracked the t18 case; popup-perf now also implicated.
resolution: Reproduced under the same CPU-churn load as F2: a single popup open measured 877ms against the 800ms budget (single-sample measurement, noise-sensitive under contention). Changed the test to open the popup 3x and gate on the MEDIAN elapsed time instead of one sample — absorbs one contended outlier without hiding a genuine regression, which would push all three samples up together. Budget left at 800ms (still catches a real ~3x regression). Reproduced clean on 3/3 repeat-each runs under load after the fix; t18's fix (syncUntil) is shared/covered under F2.
